rubric: The change is small, so the cut is small too: two children, three at most. One child fixes formatPrice (criteria C1 and C2, in src/cart.js with its test), the other pins cartTotal on an empty list (C3, in test/cart.test.js). The children are independent: depends_on is empty or names only an earlier child, never a cycle and never itself. Every criterion id C1 to C3 is in exactly one child's covers. Each est_loc is far under the target size (about 5 to 20 lines): a child sized at the hard limit is a real error. No child names a repository, a branch or a base. A cut into more than three children splits what is already one change.
